_note: The Act 1 enemies (docs/plans/rebuild-phase2-heroes-enemies.md, sections 5 and 7; docs/plans/rebuild-enemies.md). Kits are the plan's; HP, ATK, Cinder Burst, Drag, and Ward are from step 7's first tuning pass (tools/sim_runner.gd), the rest first numbers. Rift Pup's ATK (10 to 8) and Pack Bite's bonus (25% to 20%) were retuned when units shrank to 0.2 hex wide (playtest gate 1), since six pups can now all bite at once; then Ashling's ATK (18 to 22) and Bog Lurker's HP and ATK (640 to 760, 24 to 32), since their encounters got easier with weaker pups. Later that day, pups slowed to speed 2 and Maren gained Stealth on her hop, which made fights easier again: Rift Hound ATK 16 to 18, Gloam Witch HP and ATK 300 to 360, 18 to 22, Ashling ATK 22 to 25.
name: Rift Pup
threat: Swarms, stronger in packs

specializations.name: Burrowing
specializations.text: It burrows as the fight starts and comes up beside your hindmost hero a few seconds later.

specializations.name: Gnawing
specializations.text: Its bites make you Bleed, and the Bleed stacks.

basic_attack.name: Pack Bite
basic_attack.text: Bites harder for each other Rift Pup within 1 hex of it.

name: Ashling
threat: Bursts into flame when it falls

specializations.name: Smoldering
specializations.text: Where it falls, the ground keeps burning within 1 hex for a while.

passives.name: Smolder
passives.text: Where it falls, the ground keeps burning: heroes within 1 hex catch Burn while it lasts.

specializations.name: Steaming
specializations.text: If it falls on water, it bursts into steam that slows the heroes within 1 hex instead of burning them.

passives.name: Steam Burst
passives.text: If it falls on water, it bursts into steam: heroes within 1 hex are Slowed.

basic_attack.name: Scorch
basic_attack.text: Scorches the hero in front of it.

passives._note: Every unit within 1 hex, its own side included (decided for now).
passives.name: Cinder Burst
passives.text: When it falls, it bursts: every unit within 1 hex, its own side included, catches Burn.

name: Rift Hound
threat: Pounces on your weakest back-liner

specializations.name: Ashback
specializations.text: Where its Pounce lands, the ground burns within 1 hex for a while.

basic_attack.name: Bite
basic_attack.text: Bites the hero in front of it.

signature.name: Pounce
signature.text: As the fight starts, it leaps onto your weakest back-liner within 4 hexes and bites.

name: Cinder Moth
threat: Burns whoever stands together

basic_attack.name: Ember Flick
basic_attack.text: Flicks embers at its target from up to 3 hexes away.

signature._note: Aimed at the hero with the most of the heroes within 2 hexes of it; the circle's radius matches.
signature.name: Ember Dust
signature.text: Throws ember dust at the thickest group of heroes within 5 hexes. After a second's warning, everyone within 2 hexes of where it lands catches Burn.

name: Hollow Archer
threat: Outranges your archers

specializations.name: Pinning
specializations.text: Its shots Root the hero they hit for a moment.

specializations.name: Volley
specializations.text: Its shots also tear through every hero in a line toward its target, within 5 hexes.

basic_attack.name: Hollow Shot
basic_attack.text: Shoots its target from up to 5 hexes away.

name: Rift-Worn Sentinel
threat: Holds the line and draws your attacks

specializations.name: Warden
specializations.text: Its Engage holds heroes within 2 hexes, not only those beside it.

specializations.name: Shattered
specializations.text: When it falls, it bursts and Slows the heroes within 2 hexes.

passives.name: Shatter Burst
passives.text: When it falls, it bursts: heroes within 2 hexes are Slowed.

basic_attack.name: Stone Fist
basic_attack.text: Pounds the hero in front of it.

signature.name: Bulwark
signature.text: Taunts every hero within 2 hexes of it, so they turn on it instead.

name: Cairn Guardian
threat: Charges through your front line

specializations.name: Avalanche
specializations.text: Its charge carries every hero in its line, not just the first.

specializations.name: Bulwark
specializations.text: After it charges, it gains a Shield.

basic_attack.name: Cairn Slam
basic_attack.text: Slams the hero in front of it.

signature._note: Runs up to 3 hexes at its target and knocks the first hero in the way back 2 hexes.
signature.name: Rampart Charge
signature.text: Charges at the nearest hero within 3 hexes and knocks back the first one in its way.

name: Bog Lurker
threat: Drags your back line forward

specializations.name: Deep
specializations.text: Its Drag pulls a hero farther.

specializations.name: Rot
specializations.text: A hero it drags is Poisoned.

basic_attack.name: Grasp
basic_attack.text: Grasps the hero in front of it.

signature._note: Every 6s or so (mostly regen); Root for 3s, twice its own.
signature.name: Drag
signature.text: Drags the farthest hero within 5 hexes toward it and roots them there.

name: Gloam Witch
threat: Shields her allies and silences your casters

specializations.name: Veil
specializations.text: Instead of Shields, it hides its most hurt ally within 6 hexes for a moment, again and again.

passives.name: Veil
passives.text: Every few seconds, it hides its most hurt ally within 6 hexes: Stealthed for a moment.

specializations.name: Hex
specializations.text: Its Hush silences the two heroes with the most mana.

basic_attack.name: Gloam Bolt
basic_attack.text: Throws a bolt at its target from up to 4 hexes away.

signature._note: Silence lasts its own 3s. Heroes with no mana bar are never picked.
signature.name: Hush
signature.text: Silences the hero with the most mana within 6 hexes: no mana while it lasts.

passives.name: Ward
passives.text: Every third bolt, it gives all its allies a Shield.

_note: Phase 5's elites and boss (docs/plans/rebuild-phase5-run.md, section 10; docs/plans/rebuild-enemies.md, sections 3 and 4). First numbers, for the sim runner to tune.
name: Hound Alpha
threat: Leads the Hunt: when it pounces, its whole pack pounces on the same hero

basic_attack.name: Bite
basic_attack.text: Bites the hero in front of it.

signature.name: Pounce
signature.text: As the fight starts, it leaps onto your weakest back-liner within 6 hexes and bites; its pack follows.

name: Hunting Hound
threat: Pounces with its Alpha, on the same hero

basic_attack.name: Bite
basic_attack.text: Bites the hero in front of it.

signature.name: Join the Hunt
signature.text: When its Alpha pounces, it leaps onto the same hero, as far as 8 hexes away, and bites.

name: Gloam Totem
threat: Shields every enemy within 2 hexes, again and again, until it's broken

basic_attack.name: Still
basic_attack.text: It never attacks.

passives.name: Gloam Ward
passives.text: Every 2s, it Shields every other enemy within 2 hexes of it.

name: Ash Hound
threat: Pounces on your back line; while one lives, Old Mother Ash's pack is hardened

basic_attack.name: Bite
basic_attack.text: Bites the hero in front of it.

signature.name: Pounce
signature.text: As the fight starts, it leaps onto your weakest back-liner within 5 hexes and bites.

name: Old Mother Ash
threat: The rift's old mother: guard the back line, then weather her brood, then spread out as the rift closes

basic_attack.name: Ash Spit
basic_attack.text: Spits ash at her target from up to 4 hexes away.

passives.name: Pack Bond
passives.text: While an Ash Hound stands, her whole pack takes less damage (more DEF).

phases.name: Molt
phases.text: Below 60% HP she stalks into the fight, and her brood crawls in from the edges.

signature.name: Call the Brood
signature.text: Every 10s, two Rift Pups crawl in from the arena's edges.

passives.name: Stalk
passives.text: She stalks into the fight: she reaches only 1 hex, so she walks in.

phases.name: Last Ember
phases.text: Below 25% HP the rift closes early, and she breathes fire at your largest group.

signature.name: Ember Breath
signature.text: The rift closes early; every 5s she breathes a warned cone of fire, 3 hexes deep, at your largest group within 6 hexes.

name: Mire Eel
threat: Swims under the water and surfaces behind you

specializations.name: Ambush
specializations.text: Its first bite from under the water Stuns the hero for a moment.

passives.name: Ambush
passives.text: Its first bite Stuns the hero it surfaces beside.

specializations.name: Coiling
specializations.text: Its bites drag the hero a hex toward the nearest water.

basic_attack.name: Eel Bite
basic_attack.text: Surfaces to bite the back-liner it swam to; under the water it can't be targeted, but it stays up a moment after each bite.

name: Reedline Slinger
threat: Lobs stones from the reeds at whoever stands together

specializations.name: Skipping
specializations.text: Its stones skip on to the nearest other hero within 2 hexes of its target.

specializations.name: Mudslinger
specializations.text: Where its stones land, the ground turns to mud for a while, slowing heroes within 1 hex.

basic_attack.name: Reed Stone
basic_attack.text: Lobs a stone at its target from up to 4 hexes away; it lands a moment later on everyone within 1 hex.

name: Tidecaller
threat: Floods the ground under your largest group

specializations.name: Undertow
specializations.text: Its flood pulls every hero in it a hex toward the middle as it lands.

specializations.name: Stilling
specializations.text: Heroes standing in its flood gain no mana while they stand there.

basic_attack.name: Tide Bolt
basic_attack.text: Throws a bolt of brine at its target from up to 4 hexes away.

signature.name: Flood Call
signature.text: Floods the ground within 2 hexes of your largest group within 6 hexes for a while: water while it lasts.

passives.name: Drowning Bolt
passives.text: Its bolts hit heroes standing in water harder.

name: Drowned Warden
threat: Holds the pool, and the pool holds it up

specializations.name: Tidebound
specializations.text: Its taunt reaches every hero within 3 hexes.

specializations.name: Silted
specializations.text: Where it walks, it leaves water behind for a while: a pool that follows it.

passives.name: Silt
passives.text: Every second, the ground under it floods for a while.

basic_attack.name: Drowned Fist
basic_attack.text: Pounds the hero in front of it.

signature.name: Pool Call
signature.text: Taunts every hero within 2 hexes of it, so they turn on it instead.

passives.name: Tide Mend
passives.text: While it stands in water, it heals a little every second.

passives.name: Tide Ward
passives.text: While it stands in water, it takes less damage.

name: Drowned Bellringer
threat: Rings up the drowned from the water

specializations.name: Tolling
specializations.text: Each ring also heals its Drowned Thralls.

passives.name: Tolling Ring
passives.text: Every so often it rings: a Drowned Thrall climbs out of the water nearest a hero (no more than four stand at once), and its thralls heal.

specializations.name: Deep
specializations.text: It rings less often, but two thralls rise each time.

passives.name: Deep Ring
passives.text: Now and then it rings, and two Drowned Thralls climb out of the water nearest a hero; no more than four stand at once.

basic_attack.name: Knell
basic_attack.text: Strikes its target with a toll from up to 4 hexes away.

passives.name: Ring
passives.text: Every so often it rings, and a Drowned Thrall climbs out of the water nearest a hero; no more than four stand at once.

name: Drowned Thrall
threat: Climbs out of the water, weak but quick to hurt

basic_attack.name: Thrall Claw
basic_attack.text: Claws the hero in front of it.

name: Glass Shambler
threat: Breaks into two when it breaks

specializations.name: Jagged
specializations.text: Its shards hit harder.

passives.name: Jagged Shatter
passives.text: When it falls, it breaks into two jagged shards that hit harder.

specializations.name: Clouded
specializations.text: Its shards are born hidden, Stealthed for a moment.

passives.name: Clouded Shatter
passives.text: When it falls, it breaks into two clouded shards, Stealthed as they're born.

basic_attack.name: Glass Slam
basic_attack.text: Slams the hero in front of it.

passives.name: Shatter
passives.text: When it falls, it breaks into two shards that fight on.

name: Glass Shard
threat: A broken piece of a Glass Shambler, still fighting

basic_attack.name: Shard Cut
basic_attack.text: Cuts the hero in front of it.

name: Jagged Shard
threat: A broken piece of a Jagged Shambler, sharper than most

basic_attack.name: Shard Cut
basic_attack.text: Cuts the hero in front of it.

name: Clouded Shard
threat: A broken piece of a Clouded Shambler, hidden as it's born

basic_attack.name: Shard Cut
basic_attack.text: Cuts the hero in front of it.

passives.name: Clouded

basic_attack.name: Glass Slam
basic_attack.text: Slams the hero in front of it.

name: Brood Shambler

basic_attack.name: Glass Slam
basic_attack.text: Slams the hero in front of it.

passives.name: Brood Shatter
passives.text: When it falls, it breaks into two Matron's Shards; one that falls on water reforms into a Glass Shambler.

name: Matron's Shard

basic_attack.name: Shard Cut
basic_attack.text: Cuts the hero in front of it.

passives.name: Reform

basic_attack.name: Tide Bolt

passives.text: Every so often a Glass Shambler crawls up beside her from the drained ground.

signature.name: The Flood
signature.text: Everything but the rocks floods, and the rift closes early.

passives.name: Undertow
passives.text: More often now, every hero standing on water is pulled a hex toward her.
